sn56.46:1.1: The commentary identifies this realm of “utter darkness” (_andhakāratimisā_) with a cold hell realm. There is a corresponding Purāṇic hell called _andhatāmisra_. | _Agha_ (“void”) is a synonym of _ākāsa_ (“space”, [mn62:12.5]()). | _Asaṁvuta_ was translated by Ñāṇamoḷī as “abysmal”, but this relies on a commentarial cosmology that is not found in the suttas. The sense, rather, is “boundless”. The root harks back to the Vedic serpent Vṛtra who wraps the world in darkness. | _Nānubhonti_ (“makes no impression”) is glossed in the commentary to [an4.127]() as _nappahonti_ (“ineffective”).
